title: Auditor disagreement manufactures demonstrated failures using the synthesis citations
trigger: Synthesis passes each option with positive evidence; the auditor says fail with an empty basis_refs list (valid provider output).
impact: Both options become fail, retain the synthesis positive citation and synthesizer attribution, and the report publishes no_feasible_option as though each failure had been demonstrated.
validation: probes.py:audit_disagreement; probe-results.json:audit_disagreement; actual validate_output and build_report passed.
fix: Represent disputed as unknown until a scoped adverse assessment has a valid supporting basis. Preserve both verdicts, respective citations and assessor identities; use the actual supported failing assessment when deriving infeasibility.
caveat: Report reason does mention disagreement, but the authoritative failure/readiness labels still assert demonstrated failure. No live model behavior is needed for reproduction.

title: A contradicted claim chain can be promoted to supported without new evidence
trigger: New fact repeats the exact proposition of a prior contradicted fact and cites only that fact; prior fact references a contradicted source saying the opposite.
impact: Graph reachability marks the new claim grounded and validate_output leaves evidence_status=supported. Persisted-claim checks use the same status-insensitive source roots and graph, so circulation among agents can erase known contradiction.
validation: probes.py:support_laundering calls validate_output with identical prior/current proposition and explicit contradictory source; returns supported. Persistence path verified by source review.
fix: Preserve signed support/contradiction edges and evidence qualifications. Block status upgrades based solely on contradicted/mixed/stale ancestors; require a new explicit scoped support assessment and resolution record.
caveat: This is a reproducible polarity/status loss, not a claim that a graph algorithm can prove semantic entailment. Opposite propositions can legitimately cite a refutation, so relation identity and polarity must be explicit.

description_trigger_impact_validation_fi:
Selected visual findings never reach the editor.
Source: backend/src/round_robin/api/visual.py:356-374;
backend/src/round_robin/worker/image_tasks.py:218-248;
backend/src/round_robin/providers/images.py:255.
Trigger: approve an edit with intent "Address the selected finding" and a mapping
of findings to address/decline. The API saves the mapping, but _packet emits only
the free-text intent, brief and parent pixels. It omits finding IDs, observations,
regions, severities and dispositions. HTTPImageProvider.submit likewise only
serializes the brief and intent. Critic-selected feedback has no causal path to
generation unless the user manually repeats it in the intent. Declines have no
effect on the generated edit either. A paid edit can therefore ignore the exact
review findings it appears to act on.
Validation: probe.py::edit_packet_loses_dispositions; result saved in JSON.
Fix direction: construct and hash an immutable edit bundle resolving approved
parent finding IDs to observations, regions, requested changes, preserve rules
and explicit declines; transmit that exact bundle to the editor and re-reviewers.
title: Selected visual findings never reach the editor
Optional retry waiting can consume the protected synthesis and audit time
trigger: A proposal fails with a valid long Retry-After while the other two independent proposals succeed.
actual: plan_recovery checks only wait + 30 seconds. A 500-second wait is accepted within the default 600-second allowance although 190 seconds are reserved for synthesis/audit. The proposal barrier remains open. At the accepted retry time the failed proposal is skipped and synthesis immediately fails finish_time_reserve before making any model call.
impact: A run with sufficient useful proposals loses both mandatory final stages because optional backoff was allowed to spend protected finishing time. No recommendation is published.
recommendation: Compute retry eligibility from the same mandatory-stage time reserve used by authorization and request construction. If wait plus the proposed request envelope plus persistence and still-required final work cannot fit, settle the optional proposal immediately and advance with the other two. Add a deadline-triggered barrier cutoff so previously scheduled backoff cannot consume the reserve.

title: Ordinary live inputs have no path to accepted evidence support and ready_to_choose
trigger: A live run has complete correct user-entered costs, all requirements passed and distinct successful audit.
impact: Every cost source is rewritten to a synthetic user_supplied evidence record; ready dependency requires verification_status=supported. No application service promotes evidence into supported, so ordinary runs remain conditional regardless of review quality.
validation: probes.py:missing_verification_transition yields conditional with user_supplied; direct synthetic supported status yields ready. Static scan of all source writes found no supported transition.
fix: Implement explicit source-to-cost verification and immutable scoped assessment records (possibly human-attested); preserve unverified distinction. Do not fix by automatically trusting model consensus or all entered costs.
caveat: Conservative state is safer than overclaiming and may be intentional pending a verification feature; report as missing acceptance capability, not false positive readiness.

title: Evidence extraction always chooses page prefix rather than relevant or contradictory passages
trigger: A relevant cost exclusion appears after extracted character4000 of a fetched page.
impact: The only two selected passages end at4000, so no agent sees the later exclusion even though the entire page was downloaded. Long navigation and introductions consume capacity.
validation: probes.py:prefix_passages source is4249 characters with critical exclusion after4200; selected4000 omits it.
fix: Use bounded query/requirement-aware passage retrieval and diversity, preserve exact locators/hashes, explicitly search for exception/exclusion passages, and expose uninspected coverage. Evaluate recall with adversarial long-document fixtures before trusting ranking.
caveat: Current scope labels correctly state that semantic support is unchecked and design docs admit excerpt limits. This is an accuracy capability gap, not misrepresented full-document verification.

description_trigger_impact_validation_fi:
Prior visual blockers need not receive a
regression disposition in a later complete review.
Source: backend/src/round_robin/visual/reviews.py:62-84;
visual/service.py:293-317; visual/schemas.py:71-94.
Trigger: a parent has a critical finding; two child critics return empty findings.
validate_critique checks only that supplied previous_finding_id values are valid;
it does not require coverage of known prior findings. Both reviews are accepted,
and review coverage is complete with no pending-recheck limitation. No server
matrix carries unresolved blockers forward if a model omits them. Parent history
is retained, and coverage.complete does not itself claim quality; the defect is
the absent separate regression-completeness contract, not deletion of history.
Validation: probe.py::missing_regression_dispositions reproduces acceptance with
a known prior critical ID and two empty child critiques.
Fix direction: derive pending rechecks from material/critical parent findings and
locked requirements on the server. Require explicit resolved/persistent/regressed/
uncertain/declined dispositions or retain an unresolved marker. Keep pixel-review
quorum, regression completeness and quality decision separate.
title: Visual blockers have no mandatory child-version regression disposition
Intake cannot inspect newly selected attachment content or propose a normalized brief
trigger: Selected attachment text contains details relevant to resolving intake questions.
impact: The first intake packet contains attachment IDs but no selected attachment passages; evidence is prepared only for proposals. ProviderOutput has no normalized-brief proposal field and proposed_brief is copied unchanged from the input. Intake is a bounded question generator, not full document-aware normalization.
recommendation: Expose a validated read-only intake evidence view and a typed proposed change set with provenance. Require explicit user confirmation for changed assumptions, options or requirements before freezing the proposal brief.
caveat: The blueprint orders intake before evidence preparation. This is a capability gap, not evidence that proposal agents lose the attachment; the proposal packet includes it. No live intake quality was measured.

title: Schema repair retries receive no actionable validation feedback
trigger: A provider returns an invalid reference or malformed/schema-invalid output and has one retry remaining.
impact: The second packet differs only by repair=true. The rejected reference, failed JSON path and validation reason are absent, and the common prompt does not define repair. This implements bounded regeneration, with no demonstrated targeted correction capability.
recommendation: Include sanitized bounded diagnostics with offending field paths and permitted identities, optionally the bounded rejected structured output as untrusted data; distinguish execution retry from output repair and substantive correction.
caveat: A fresh generation can succeed. The reproduction proves missing feedback, not that every retry fails or that real-provider quality decreases by a measured amount.

title: First query exhausts page allowance and starves cost/counterevidence retrieval
trigger: Ordinary first comparison query returns eight valid unique hits.
impact: All eight fetch slots go to first-query results. Later cost and counterevidence searches still consume authorizations but none of their pages can be fetched; summary lists all three queries and no limitations.
validation: probes.py:counterevidence_starvation runs real execute_research with synthetic SQLite ledger and stub search/page transports; all saved URLs are query1, later_query_sources_fetched=0, limitations=[].
fix: Reserve page slots per objective or interleave candidate collection and acquisition; stop searches that cannot yield inspectable evidence or record discovery-only results explicitly; disclose unsatisfied research objectives.
caveat: Plan rotation is locally correct; execution allocation is the failure. Duplicate hits or early failed fetches can change outcomes, but eight fresh hits are sufficient.

title: Bounded dissent aggregation can discard the final auditor and ignores proposal critical defects
trigger: Two earlier proposals provide twelve distinct dissent strings each; final auditor contributes material dissent/critical text. Separately, a proposal puts a concern in critical_defects and later stages omit it.
impact: Only first20 dissent strings publish, omitting all final auditor specifics. Proposal critical_defects never enter aggregate and do not set unresolved_critical_defect unless the last audit repeats them.
validation: probes.py:dissent_loss returns dissent_count=20 and no AUDITOR marker; separate proposal-critical probe produces empty dissent and false unresolved flag.
fix: Maintain objection IDs, targets, materiality, dispositions and response links across stages; reserve display capacity for unresolved audit defects and attach overflow links/counts rather than silently dropping records.
caveat: Saved contributions preserve the original text and the final-audit generic unresolved flag survives. Claim is loss from report aggregation/required resolution, not deletion from storage.

Renamed copies inflate the 48-task release
denominator.
Source: experiments/release.py:32-38; analogous exact-hash-only duplicate checking
in experiments/visual_evaluation.py:54-55.
Trigger: submit 48 briefs with identical question, options and evidence, changing
only the title of a valid DraftBrief and assigning required stratum labels. validate_manifest accepts
them because complete JSON hashes differ. summarize reports 48 independent primary
tasks and can meet the numerical target from one substantive case. The separate
phase_5_passed flag correctly stays false. FrozenStudyManifest has stronger alias
normalization at study_runner.py:110-123, but release manifests do not reuse it.
Validation: probe.py::aliased_release_cases reports one substantive case as 48
independent useful primaries with numerical_usefulness_target=true.
Fix direction: bind normalized substantive-case fingerprints, development-case
fingerprints and explicit provenance/stratum review; reject known aliases. Human

title: Alias-only variations inflate release independent-case denominator
Preflight accepts selected evidence that cannot fit any proposal request
trigger: A selected UTF-8 attachment has 40,000 CJK characters (120,000 bytes), fits the upload limit and 20 evidence passages, with the ordinary sample brief.
impact: The real preflight input check returns no error. Intake succeeds; all three proposals fail context_limit before authorization, and the run fails without a recommendation. Character/passage limits do not imply the 128,000-byte complete JSON packet fits.
recommendation: Build and size the exact canonical initial packet during preflight, including UTF-8 encoding and all overhead. Reserve a bounded peer/claim context envelope for mandatory downstream stages, with explicit coverage when selecting context. Reject or ask for narrower excerpts before starting.
acceptance_check: Boundary/property cases across ASCII, multi-byte UTF-8, quotes/escapes, maximum selected passages and peer/claim growth must either fit the declared envelopes or produce a preflight blocker.

title: The discussion activity view silently stops at the first 100 events
trigger: A run accumulates more than 100 committed events, such as through retries, research or reconciliation.
impact: Snapshot intentionally returns the first 100 events plus next_event_cursor, but the frontend never consumes the cursor or events endpoint. A 134-event reproduction shows only sequences 1-100 and omits the late concern. Polling repeats the same prefix and stops on terminal status; raw server history remains available.
proof: root/probe-results.json:event_snapshot_pagination; API reproduction plus static client call-path inspection
recommendation: Fetch bounded event pages through the snapshot cutoff and merge by (run_id, sequence); expose loading/remaining history and retain generation fences when changing runs.
acceptance_check: A component/API test with 250 events, late critical concerns, duplicate pages, reconnection and a run switch must show the complete correctly ordered history exactly once.

title: At-least-once duplicate execution bypasses Retry-After
trigger: A worker saves a retryable failure and its future outbox intention; an older duplicate message for the same Step is delivered before that intention is due.
actual: Retry eligibility is represented only by Outbox.due_at. execute_step sees status=pending and immediately authorizes another call. The probe's requested wait was 120 seconds; the second provider invocation occurred about 0.012 seconds later and consumed the last allowed call.
impact: Provider Retry-After is not an execution invariant. Expected duplicate delivery can exhaust retries during a rate-limit period, reduce discussion completeness, and amplify provider pressure.
recommendation: Persist a step/attempt not-before timestamp or retry generation, enforce it under the step lock before authorization, and carry the generation in delivery identifiers. Keep at-least-once delivery harmless across retry state transitions.

title: Clarification and manual retry bypass queue quotas
trigger: An owner already has the allowed three queued runs and confirms an awaiting-input run (or requests an eligible retry).
actual: Only initial Start counts queued work. The resumption endpoints set queued and issue a ticket without checking owner/global queue counts. The direct clarification probe increased the owner's queue from three to four with a configured limit of three.
impact: The documented owner/global admission backlog bounds are not maintained across all enqueue transitions, weakening fairness and overload protection. This does not bypass single-executing-run or monetary limits.
recommendation: Apply one owner/global queue-capacity guard under the existing policy lock to every transition into queued, including clarification and retry; leave the resumable state intact when capacity is unavailable.

description_trigger_impact_validation_fi:
The study does not execute the production
correction/re-audit protocol it could be used to justify.
Source: experiments/study_runner.py:545-578 versus production
backend/src/round_robin/orchestration/controller.py:335.
Trigger: a valid final audit rejects synthesis while allowance remains. Production
can reserve and run a corrected synthesis and second audit. FundedStudyRunner
ends immediately as limited, even with only 12 calls and less than one second of
synthetic elapsed time. Its ProviderRequest construction at study_runner.py:463
also does not populate the production claim-version context. The study is a
legitimate separate fixed-evidence experiment, but its result cannot establish
accuracy, cost or latency of the current production protocol without a parity
contract and explicit qualification.
Validation: probe.py::study_failed_audit uses existing synthetic approval fixtures
and injected HTTP mocks. Trace: 3 proposal, 3 critique, 1 evidence_review, 3
revision, 1 synthesis, 1 audit; final status limited; no correction/re-audit.
Fix direction: share a versioned transition policy with the production runner,
freeze that policy hash in study configuration, and test protocol traces across
both runners. If deliberately evaluating an ablation, label the omitted stages.
